text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The strongest have gathered here at Tokyo Racecourse in Fuchu!
The curtain is about to rise on a historic race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: Lady Ardan...――
...I'll see it through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Before we head into the race, please let me say just this one thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: With you as my Trainer, I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I was happy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Please bear witness.
To the moment the "now" we built together
shatters the promised history—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu... What an amazing form~.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds good.
Now all the actors are assembled!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ......That's amazing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Even so, I won't lose either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Oguri, Creek, Inari...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(To all of you who live in the same "now" as me,
and continue to shine so brilliantly...
I give you my deepest thanks.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Those dazzling, unfading days given to me by my beloved rivals—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (The memory of a glorious race—running side by side beyond our limits—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Without losing a single piece of any of it, I will transform it all into my radiance "now" and challenge you.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Our Tenno Sho (Autumn)—
